svg.title: prepare_data — source preparation, extraction and individual data checks
svg.desc: Expand uploaded-file and saved-simulation branches into their individual operations. Show computed recording modes, semantic worker validation and retries, per-variable numerical checks, warning outcomes and atomic publication. No causal model is read.
